concept: A cheap dart thrower whose three purchases lead to a rebounding spiked ball, a fast triple throw with a timed frenzy, and a long range crossbow with personal Camo detection.

signature.name: Dart Throw
signature.adaptation: The ordinary dart throw stays the base attack; every path develops that one throw instead of adding separate weapons.

repertoire.name: Spiked Ball
repertoire.limitation: Rebounds off obstacles need wall geometry that the Definition does not model.

repertoire.name: Triple Throw
repertoire.limitation: The thirty degree arc becomes three darts aimed at the selected target.

repertoire.name: Fan Club
repertoire.limitation: Only this Unit's own frenzy can be a manual boost; transforming nearby allies is unsupported.

repertoire.name: Crossbow
repertoire.limitation: Counted critical shots have no operator and stay unsupported.

base.name: Dart Throw
base.behavior: Throws one sharp dart at the selected target on a steady interval; it cannot target Camo enemies or damage Lead and Frozen enemies.

path1.name: Juggernaut Line
path1.buyFor: Dense lanes where one throw can pass through many enemies.
path1.weakness: Throws stay slow and have no Camo detection, so sparse or hidden enemies waste most of the ball's pierce.

tier2.change: 2-x-x raises dart pierce by two more.

tier3.change: 3-x-x replaces the dart with a heavier spiked ball that deals more damage, reaches farther and pierces far more enemies, at a slower throw. The ball rebounds: after each throw hits, up to two other nearby enemies take half its damage once each.

tier4.change: 4-x-x throws the ball faster, multiplies its pierce and switches it to normal damage so it can hit Lead.

tier5.change: 5-x-x raises ball damage and pierce again and replaces the rebound with a split: after each throw hits, up to twelve smaller balls strike other nearby enemies once each.

path1.capstoneValue: One throw clears a whole cluster and its split covers enemies the ball missed.

path2.name: Fan Club Line
path2.buyFor: Steady streams where more darts per second matter more than pierce.
path2.weakness: Each dart keeps low damage and pierce, and the frenzy only helps while enemies stay in range.

tier2.change: x-2-x shortens the attack interval again.

tier3.change: x-3-x throws three darts at the selected target per attack and throws faster.

tier4.change: x-4-x halves the interval again and unlocks a manual frenzy that makes this Unit attack far faster for a short window.

tier5.change: x-5-x doubles dart damage during the frenzy and lengthens the frenzy window.

path2.capstoneValue: The frenzy window turns into the Unit's peak damage moment instead of only a speed spike.

path3.name: Crossbow Line
path3.buyFor: Long lanes and hidden enemies that the other paths cannot see.
path3.weakness: Bolts pierce few enemies until the last purchase, so dense groups still leak.

tier2.change: x-x-2 extends range again and lets this Unit target Camo enemies.

tier3.change: x-x-3 replaces the dart with a crossbow bolt that strikes its target instantly, deals more damage, pierces more enemies and reaches much farther.

tier4.change: x-x-4 doubles bolt damage and fires twice as often.

tier5.change: x-x-5 raises bolt damage, fires twice as often again, doubles pierce and switches to normal damage so bolts hit Lead.

path3.capstoneValue: Sustained precise fire at long range with access to Lead enemies.

omittedTechniques.name: Allied Fan Club
omittedTechniques.reason: Transforming nearby allied Units needs an ally operator that the Definition lacks.

omittedTechniques.name: Critical shots
omittedTechniques.reason: Every tenth or fifth shot dealing extra damage needs a shot counter operator.

scopeLimits: Rebounds, knockback and Ceramic or Fortified bonuses have no operator and stay unsupported.
